title: Grateful Dead Live at Fillmore West on 1970-06-04
lineage: SBD > RM > Cass > ? > DAT > CD > EAC > SHN

ai_review.summary: Excellent soundboard recording that captures a tight June 4‑1970 Fillmore show highlighted by a soaring St. Stephen jam, funky Midnight Hour/China Cat medley and an emotionally charged Baby Blue.
ai_review.review: The SBD source is crystal clear – guitars forward, drums crisp and Pigpen’s organ “extra churchy” sits perfectly in the mix. Musically the band is on fire: a full‑on St. Stephen jam, a rolling Midnight Hour that weaves into China Cat Sunflower/I Know You Rider, and a soulful Baby Blue that many reviewers call the best they’ve heard. Overall the performance feels tight, inspired and representative of the Dead’s peak 1970 era.

ai_rating.rationale: All detailed reviews praise both the musical execution (standout jams, tight rhythm section) and the soundboard quality; no negative comments were noted.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Guitars front‑center, drums crisp, organ bright, vocals clear; only minor pauses noted but they do not detract from the overall clarity.

standout_songs: China Cat Sunflower > I Know You Rider
show_quality.setlist_flow: Two‑set show with a strong first set of folk‑rock numbers and a second set that builds into extended jams; transitions such as Midnight Hour → China Cat → Midnight Hour are highlighted for their seamless flow.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Vocals praised on Baby Blue; overall presence noted as soulful.
band_member_comments.Bob: Bobby’s (Weir) guitar/lead work described as “high in the mix” and “superb noodling”.
band_member_comments.Keys: Pigpen’s organ called “extra churchy”, “crazy organ” and a key element of the soulful vibe.
band_member_comments.Drums: Drums described as crisp and tight throughout.
